what: P22: Shared::versions as an arena. On PE every import of an import library has its own "<hint> <name>" version, so Shared::versions: Vec<String> is one allocation per import (thousands for windows.lib), the last per-symbol String in the PE reader. Make it versions: Names plus Vec<Name> (SharedSymbol::version: Option<u16> indexing it), Shared::version unchanged for callers. Spec: /tmp/blaze-lanes/v2-link-requests.md ### P22. pe/coff.rs follows once it lands.

history.note: model.rs: Shared::versions is Vec<Name> into Shared::names (one arena, no second Names); Shared::version unchanged for callers. elf/read/shared.rs pushes each version once into names; pe/coff.rs add() pushes the export name into names; tests adjusted (elf/read/tests.rs compares texts, pe/tests.rs). pe/coff.rs Imported::version is still a String per import: write it straight into the arena to drop that allocation.
